description: This file defines the Wraps class and the WrapsImpl interface, which appear to be designed for mocking system calls and related functionalities in tests, particularly within the 'networkmanager-34' project. It includes virtual methods for system operations and static methods to access or set the implementation instance.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: An abstract interface class with pure virtual methods for system-related functions, intended for mocking or override implementations.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: A singleton-like class providing static accessors and mutators for system call operations, utilizing an implementation of WrapsImpl.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the static implementation instance used by Wraps.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Wraps.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Calls the system command via the implementation.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Opens a process by creating a pipe, via the implementation.

methods.name: pclose
methods.description: Closes a pipe returned by popen.

methods.name: syslog
methods.description: Logs system messages via the implementation.

methods.name: setmntent
methods.description: Starts reading from a mount table.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Secure version of popen, with va_list arguments.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Closes a FILE pointer obtained from v_secure_popen.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Secure system call with va_list arguments.

methods.name: readlink
methods.description: Reads the value of a symbolic link.
